title: STN Ultradesign award reference index
scope: A selected discovery catalogue, not a census, ranking, or audit of the live products. Exactly 216 distinct named awarded projects. No nominees or finalists counted.

inspection_depths.D0: Award metadata verified; no product design inspection claimed.
inspection_depths.D1: Selected primary product documentation or creator case study read; not visual or runtime verification.
inspection_depths.D2: Rendered reference image or page inspected at a recorded viewport; no runtime assurance.
inspection_depths.D3: Specific live interaction exercised with recorded device, input, state, and result; not a full product audit.

limitations: The CSSDA selection was discovered with month/year-focused searches and then checked against official project pages; it is not a complete or random archive sample.
All 184 CSSDA source pages returned HTTP 200 and consistent award dates; their 184 distinct linked destination URLs were extracted, not interactively tested.
Apple records link to the exact annual official page containing the named winner; null project URLs mean the destination has not been separately resolved.
Award date and product/document version are different; current product documents may postdate the awarded version.
Seven catalogue projects have D1 document analysis. Two additional industrial/business examples in the accompanying report are excluded from the count because their award years were not established.
No third-party images, source code, design assets, or skills are included.
